Title: LSJ: Ritual Of The Bitter Rose Q

Messages.Author: GP41
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Questions about Ritual of the Bitter Rose.

1) Is RotBR only applicable toward Diablerize action, or can i also use
it for Sacrifice of the Lamb?

2) In a given combat, could i use it if i burned the opposing vamp with
a massive agg damage combo, or only with Amarant?

GP41

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <3BA2D106...@videotron.ca>, GP41 <GP...@videotron.ca>
writes

>1) Is RotBR only applicable toward Diablerize action, or can i also use
>it for Sacrifice of the Lamb?

"{()} Each ready vampire you control gains an amount of blood from the
blood bank equal to the amount of blood on {a vampire being burned
either by diablerie or while in combat with this vampire}."

Sacrificial Lamb is neither diablerie or burning a vampire in combat.

>2) In a given combat, could i use it if i burned the opposing vamp with
>a massive agg damage combo, or only with Amarant?

You could, since that would be a vampire being burned in combat, thus
satisfying card text.
